description: Monero node state: height vs target, sync flag, difficulty, txpool size, database size, monerod version and peer counts. When to use: whether the XMR node is synced and healthy, or how big its chain and txpool are. Do not use: for fees call xmr_get_fee_rates; for one transaction call xmr_get_transaction; for network-wide numbers call xmr_get_network_stats. RobotBase does not index Monero wallets or ring signatures. Returns: height, target_height, synced, status, network, difficulty, txpool_txs, database_size_gb, block_size_limit, version, incoming_connections / outgoing_connections.
name: xmr_get_node_status
title: Xmr Get Node Status
